name: rosetta-move-to-front-algorithm
code:
use default
use System.Text.StringBuilder

symbol_table() -> LIST[char] is
    let symbols = LIST(26)

    for code in cast int('a')::cast int('z') do
        symbols.add(cast char(code))
    od

    return symbols
si

move_to_front(symbols: LIST[char], at: int) is
    let symbol = symbols[at]

    symbols.remove_at(at)
    symbols.insert(0, symbol)
si

encode(text: string) -> List[int] is
    let symbols = symbol_table()
    let indices = LIST(text.length)

    for symbol in text do
        let at = symbols.index_of(symbol)

        indices.add(at)
        move_to_front(symbols, at)
    od

    return indices
si

decode(indices: List[int]) -> string is
    let symbols = symbol_table()
    let text = StringBuilder()

    for at in indices do
        text.append(symbols[at])
        move_to_front(symbols, at)
    od

    return text.to_string()
si

for original in ["broood", "bananaaa", "hiphophiphop"] do
    let encoded = encode(original)
    let decoded = decode(encoded)

    let indices = encoded |> join(" ")

    let verdict =
        if decoded =~ original then
            "decodes to the original"
        else
            "does not decode to the original"
        fi

    write_line("{original,-14}{indices,-30}{verdict}")
od
